Author: NeonGhostCinnamon
Name: Will-o-Muter
Punchline: Mutes the ambient sounds when a crowd gathers around you.
Description: Tired of noisy crowds? Will-o-Muter mutes the Ambient Sounds channel when many players are nearby and restores your volume once the crowd thins out. Open the settings with /willomuter.
Changelog:
- New theme button: pick Dark, Light or Dalamud (uses your Dalamud style's colours)
- New icon
- Lighter grey text for better readability
